limitations: All 906 successful operations were byte-for-byte qualified by the source-pinned receiver verifier; this analysis checks that receipt and does not repeat the entire storage comparison.

Primary paired byte results are exact HTTP request-plus-response body counts, excluding HTTP headers, TLS, TCP/IP and the tunnel. Full 30-pair IP ratios are unqualified because reused TCP tuples were quarantined.
Zero reported kernel drops does not erase tuple ambiguity or establish complete observation; tcpdump reported one more packet received by filter than captured.
Raw-CAS is the direct identical-repeat control; its savings must not be attributed to DAG-specific mathematics.
Zstd is the strongest observed structured-cold control; no best-arm selection policy was measured.
Localized edits change 32 bytes while scattered edits change 1024 bytes; do not infer a controlled equal-edit-budget comparison.
Prefix insertion changes object length and shifts fixed chunk alignment; its measured negative must remain in the result.
Known-absent target arms use one batched HTTP request; baseline is not penalized by one RTT per chunk. Receiver raw mode also performs the existing graph-warming work.
End-to-end wall includes required graph/codec preparation and delivery through durable Published; synthetic input generation and qualification are excluded and measured separately.

Receiver handler CPU excludes cloudflared and provider relay. Aggregate cloudflared process time is separately observed; different CPU architectures do not imply comparable energy or instruction counts.

Warm mutation seed-plus-transfer costs include matched base seeds for both arms. Repeat full-copy controls have empty targets and no seed; charging warm priming as additional overhead gives two-repeat break-even. If the seed already served a required initial delivery, that shared initial cost is not additional overhead.
Seed break-even is a constant-cost extrapolation, not a measured long update sequence.
30 paired trials per 1 MiB arm reflect one synthetic corpus and one relay route/window; 16 MiB cases are n=1 smoke observations and random16MiB DAG is not qualified.
No FIPS validation, MVM integration, universal compression ratio, energy claim or general WAN latency win follows from these measurements.

The zstd_full control is this profile's independent 60 KiB level-1 zstd chunks with raw fallback, not an optimized continuous zstd stream or trained dictionary. No rsync, content-defined chunking, delta-compression, or external protocol baseline was measured; savings against full copies do not establish novelty or superiority over other warm-cache systems.
